betterquesting:10.desc:8: §3With automatic input enabled, supported hatches and buses pull compatible fluids or items from the inventory directly in front of them. A screwdriver cycles the filter and auto-input settings; on an input bus, sneak-right-click changes its sorting and stack-limit settings. Transfers are rate-limited: a fluid hatch moves up to 1,000 mB every 100 ticks, and a bus processes up to one inventory slot per 100 ticks.§r
